content.json:
## AgentOps · Copilot agent telemetry
Metadata only — no prompts, responses, code, file paths or private URLs. Pick a workspace, time window and run. **Empty means not observed, never success.** Requested and recorded models are shown separately; nothing here proves complete capture, independent model execution or business benefit.

parameters.name: RunId
parameters.label: Run (bounded to newest 500)
parameters.query:
union (AgentOpsRunSummary_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, RunId), (AgentOpsEvents_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, RunId), (AgentOpsSpans_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project TimeGenerated, RunId)
| where isnotempty(RunId)
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by RunId
| top 500 by LastSeen desc
| project value=RunId, label=RunId
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string)['*', 'All observed runs'])

content.title: At a glance
content.noDataMessage: No metadata rows observed in this window. Publish with VS Code `AgentOps: Publish native metadata to Azure` or CLI `agentops azure-ingest`.

content.title: Telemetry rows over time
content.query:
union
(AgentOpsEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend Stream="events"),
(AgentOpsSpans_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend Stream="spans"),
(AgentOpsToolCalls_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend Stream="tool calls"),
(AgentOpsMcpCalls_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend Stream="MCP calls")
| make-series Rows=count() default=0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain} by Stream
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No events, spans or tool calls in this window. Publish with VS Code `AgentOps: Publish native metadata to Azure` or CLI `agentops azure-ingest`.

content.title: Observed streams, coverage limits and delivery evidence
content.query:
union
(AgentOpsRunSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsRunSummary_CL"),
(AgentOpsEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsEvents_CL"),
(AgentOpsSpans_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsSpans_CL"),
(AgentOpsToolCalls_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsToolCalls_CL"),
(AgentOpsMcpCalls_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsMcpCalls_CL"),
(AgentOpsPrivacy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsPrivacy_CL"),
(AgentOpsEval_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsEval_CL"),
(AgentOpsGithubOutcomes_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsGithubOutcomes_CL"),
(AgentOpsInsights_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsInsights_CL"),
(AgentOpsRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId | extend SourceTable="AgentOpsRecommendations_CL")
| summarize ReadbackRows=count(), LastReadbackRow=max(TimeGenerated) by RunId, SourceTable
| extend ReadbackEvidence="Azure query-visible rows only", UploadAcknowledgment="unknown; local receipt not in table contract", CaptureCompleteness="unknown; row presence does not establish coverage"
| order by LastReadbackRow desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No AgentOps rows in this window, so delivery is not observed. Publish with VS Code `AgentOps: Publish native metadata to Azure` or CLI `agentops azure-ingest`.

content.title: Runs, model provenance and nullable usage / cost
content.query:
AgentOpsRunSummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, SessionId, TraceId, AgentName, Surface, TaskType, ModelRequested, ModelActual, OutcomeStatus, InputTokens, OutputTokens, EstimatedCostUsdReal, TestsRan, TestsPassed, CiStatus, PrivacyMode, SchemaVersion
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId
| extend RequestedModel=iff(isempty(ModelRequested), "unknown", ModelRequested), RecordedActualModel=iff(isempty(ModelActual), "unknown", ModelActual), ActualModelProvenance="recorded metadata; independent execution not established", Outcome=iff(isempty(OutcomeStatus), "unknown", OutcomeStatus), UsageEvidence=iff(isnull(InputTokens) or isnull(OutputTokens), "partial or unknown", "recorded run summary"), CostEvidence=iff(isnull(EstimatedCostUsdReal), "unknown", "recorded estimate; not invoice"), CaptureCompleteness="unknown; no affirmative coverage field"
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, SessionId, TraceId, AgentName, Surface, TaskType, RequestedModel, RecordedActualModel, ActualModelProvenance, Outcome, InputTokens, OutputTokens, UsageEvidence, EstimatedCostUsdReal, CostEvidence, TestsRan, TestsPassed, CiStatus, PrivacyMode, CaptureCompleteness, SchemaVersion
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No run summaries in this window. Run summaries come from CLI `agentops run-summary`; native VS Code capture publishes events only. Outcome stays unknown.

content.title: Model request versus recorded actual event evidence
content.query:
AgentOpsEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, EventId, Sequence, EventName, Status, ModelRequested, ModelActual, Provider
| where isnotempty(ModelRequested) or isnotempty(ModelActual)
| extend ActualModelProvenance=iff(isempty(ModelActual), "unknown; request is not actual", "recorded event; independent execution not established")
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No model request or recorded actual model in this window. Requested model is never treated as actual.

content.title: Tool, MCP and script execution / failures
content.query:
union
(AgentOpsToolCalls_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, SpanId, ToolName, ToolType, ToolRisk, Status, Allowed, DurationMs | extend Lane="tool"),
(AgentOpsMcpCalls_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, SpanId, ToolName, McpServerName, ToolRisk, Status, Allowed, DurationMs | extend Lane="mcp"),
(AgentOpsEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, EventId, EventName, ToolName, McpServerName, ScriptName, ScriptRuntimeName, ScriptLoaderName, Status, ErrorType, ExitCode, DurationMs | where isnotempty(ScriptName) or isnotempty(ErrorType) or (isnotnull(ExitCode) and ExitCode != 0) | extend Lane="event / script")
| extend RecordedStatus=iff(isempty(Status), "unknown", Status), FailureEvidence=case(isnotempty(ErrorType), "recorded error type", isnotnull(ExitCode) and ExitCode != 0, "recorded nonzero exit", Status in~ ("error", "failed", "failure", "denied", "blocked"), "recorded failure / denial", "no failure signal in this row; success unknown")
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, Lane, ToolName, McpServerName, ScriptName, ScriptRuntimeName, ScriptLoaderName, RecordedStatus, FailureEvidence, Allowed, ErrorType, ExitCode, DurationMs, TraceId, SpanId, EventId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No tool, MCP or script rows in this window. Success remains unknown, not assumed.

content.title: Span lineage and attribution evidence
content.query:
AgentOpsSpans_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, OperationName, AgentName, ToolName, McpServerName, McpToolName, ScriptName, ToolCallEvidence, LinkType, Outcome, ErrorType, DurationMs
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No spans in this window. Start capture with VS Code `AgentOps: Connect native capture`, then publish.

content.title: Opaque evidence references for local ledger investigation
content.query:
AgentOpsEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, SessionId, TraceId, EventId, ParentEventId, Sequence, EventName, ToolCallId, ParentToolCallId, AgentId, ParentAgentId
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No event references in this window. Publish with VS Code `AgentOps: Publish native metadata to Azure` or CLI `agentops azure-ingest`.

content.title: Privacy receipts and explicit unknown verdicts
content.query:
AgentOpsPrivacy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, ContentKind, Action, Observed, LeakDetected, DroppedCount, RedactedCount, PrivacyMode
| extend PrivacyEvidence=case(isnull(Observed), "unknown", Observed == false, "not observed", isnull(LeakDetected), "observed; leak verdict unknown", LeakDetected == true, "leak signal; investigate", "recorded no-leak verdict; not a complete privacy guarantee")
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No privacy receipts in this window. No-leak verdict is unknown, not clean.

content.title: Workspace-wide collector health (not run-filtered)
content.query:
AgentOpsCollectorHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, Component, Status, CheckName, CollectorMode, PrivacyMode, AzureConfigured, PrivacyPoisonOk, DroppedContentCount, ExportErrors, LastExportSuccess, LastSpanReceived
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Component, CheckName
| extend HealthScope="workspace-wide; schema has no RunId", LastExportEvidence=iff(isnull(LastExportSuccess), "unknown", "recorded collector export timestamp; not full readback"), HeartbeatAge=now()-TimeGenerated
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No collector heartbeat in this window (workspace-wide). Check `agentops health` or VS Code `AgentOps: Capture status`.

content.title: Recorded deterministic evaluations; missing scores stay null
content.query:
AgentOpsEval_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, TaskType, ModelActual, EvalOverall, EvalBucket, Reliability, Security, TestDiscipline, ToolEfficiency, ContextEfficiency, CodeOutcome
| extend ScoreEvidence=iff(isnull(EvalOverall), "unknown", "recorded deterministic grade; execution tier not in schema")
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No evaluation rows in this window. Missing scores stay null, never zero.

content.title: Measured code outcomes; unknown booleans stay null
content.query:
AgentOpsGithubOutcomes_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, RepoHash, PrNumberHash, PrOpened, PrMerged, PrClosed, PrReverted, CiStatus, CommitCount, FilesChangedCount, ReviewCommentCount, TimeToPrMinutes, TimeToMergeMinutes
| extend OutcomeEvidence="recorded GitHub state; causal benefit not established"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No GitHub outcome rows in this window. Enrich with CLI `agentops github-enrich`. Unknown booleans stay null.

content.title: Architecture insights and bounded evidence references
content.query:
AgentOpsInsights_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, InsightId, InsightType, Severity, Rule, ArchitectureVersion, Numerator, Denominator, CoverageRuns, Status, Evidence
| extend EvidenceIds=Evidence.evidenceIds, CoverageLimits=tostring(Evidence.coverageLimits)
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, TraceId, InsightId, InsightType, Severity, Rule, ArchitectureVersion, Numerator, Denominator, CoverageRuns, Status, EvidenceIds, CoverageLimits
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No architecture insights in this window. Generate with CLI `agentops insights`.

content.title: Recommendation identifiers and controlled actions
content.query:
AgentOpsRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}') == '*' or RunId == base64_decode_tostring('{RunId:base64}')
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, SessionId, TraceId, RecommendationId, Action, Severity, EvalOverall, EvalBucket
| extend Decision="proposal only; human review required"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.noDataMessage: No recommendations in this window. Generate with CLI `agentops recommend`; every action needs human review.

content.json:
## Interpretation and privacy limits

Counts describe rows observed in this window, not expected deliveries or capture coverage. Retries may duplicate rows. Health is workspace-wide because its table has no RunId. Numeric and boolean blanks remain unknown; estimated cost is not billed cost. Run and event IDs are linkable metadata. No arbitrary dynamic evidence object, recommendation text, health detail or endpoint is rendered. Metadata projection and least-privilege table access must be qualified before private data onboarding. Local replay and independently verified receipts remain the authority for detailed investigation.
